name: Okabe Rintarou
source: Unable to overcome the first failure in saving [url=https://vndb.org/c6487]Kurisu[/url], Okabe accepted and lived miserably in Beta Worldline, ignored the warning about the 3rd World War of [url=https://vndb.org/c73598]Suzuha[/url] - a traveler from 2036 to help him reach Steins Gate. He chooses to live a normal life with severe PTSD whenever he remembers his assistant.

He chooses to live a normal life with severe PTSD whenever he remembers his assistant.
